name: video-player-ui
title: Video Player UI
description: Video controls on a 16:9 stage: a big play button, scrub bar, time readout, speed cycle and fullscreen. It runs its own clock and loads no media.

props.name: children
props.description: The picture area: a poster, a video element you control, or any node.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled play state. Pair with onPlayingChange.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Called by the play buttons and when the clip ends.

props.name: currentTime
props.description: Controlled position in seconds. Pair with onTimeChange.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called on every tick and seek; mirror it onto a real video element.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the player group.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
